description: This script interacts with the GitHub GraphQL API to search for repositories based on language, activity, and star count, and writes the top repositories to a file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates repository collection and writing to file.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Performs a paginated GraphQL query to fetch repositories matching criteria.

methods.name: get_end_cursor
methods.description: Extracts the end cursor for pagination from API response.

methods.name: get_repositories
methods.description: Filters repositories from API response based on privacy, disable, lock status, and star count.
